payout_quote: Start them off strong with $100* deposited directly into their account after you refer them. $100 FOR YOU. $100 FOR THEM.
steps: Be a Camino Federal Credit Union member
Tell friends/family about Camino; your friend must mention your name when opening their new accounts
Friend opens a Membership Savings Account and a Checking Account (any type); accounts must be open and in good standing
You and your friend each receive a $100 deposit into your respective accounts
catches: Seasonal promotion framing (‘Give the Gift of Membership This Holiday Season’) — qualifying detail beyond ‘open and in good standing’ is not stated on the public promo page
Membership limited to those who live, work, worship, or attend school in Montebello or within a 10-mile radius
No stated cap on the public page
Referrer and referee accounts must be in good standing when rewards are paid
biggest_catch: $100 each is generous — but this is a seasonally-framed promo, and the public page states no detailed qualifying activities beyond accounts open and in good standing.
eligibility: Camino Federal Credit Union members; new members eligible for Camino membership (Montebello area)
timing: Paid once both accounts are open and in good standing
